name: Marlo
bio: Marlo travels with an old film camera and a notebook full of sunsets. He hopes to photograph the zoo animals at feeding time.
reason: a photo series about small towns

name: Ines
bio: Ines spent forty years teaching geography and now visits the places she used to draw on the board. She asks everyone for directions, even when she knows the way.
reason: a quiet holiday by the forest

name: Theo
bio: Theo studies old trees and keeps pressed leaves in every pocket. He heard the forest grove has oaks older than the village.
reason: research on the old forest grove

name: Yara
bio: Yara writes a weekly column about honest food in small places. She has heard rumours about the burgers here and wants to taste them herself.
reason: a column about the Burger Joint

name: Bodo
bio: Bodo checks railway lines all over the country and always rides in the first carriage. He collects ticket stubs and train stories.

name: Lina
bio: Lina sketches everything she sees, from rooftops to crows. She wants to paint the Ferris wheel at dusk.
reason: sketching the rides and the zoo

name: Olek
bio: Olek trades cheese from farm to farm and can tell a good wheel by its smell. He wants to see how the barn here makes theirs.

name: Suki
bio: Suki looks after penguins at a big city zoo and spends her holidays visiting other zoos. She talks to animals as if they were old friends.
reason: visiting the penguins at the zoo

name: Fenn
bio: Fenn plays the fiddle in town squares for coins and cake. He knows a song for every kind of weather.

name: Greta
bio: Greta keeps a list of every bird she has ever seen and is still missing a few. She heard a crow lives on the post office roof.
reason: watching the birds and ducks in the forest

name: Pavel
bio: Pavel designs cosy sweaters and is always looking for soft wool. He knits while he waits for anything, even trains.

name: Noor
bio: Noor writes guidebooks about places that are not in guidebooks yet. She takes notes on every bench, bakery and rumour.
reason: writing a chapter about the village

name: Rufus
bio: Rufus sailed around the world twice and now prefers solid ground and a good burger. He tells sea stories to anyone who sits down next to him.

name: Elif
bio: Elif just finished her studies and wants to work with farm animals. She is here to see how a small farm runs.
